title: Efficiency
cardText: Every penny and every minute counts and we make them count for you. Our onsite-offshore delivery model ensures cost...
body: Every penny counts and we make them count for you. Our onsite-offshore delivery model ensures cost, time and delivery efficiency across time zones. We follow the typical software development lifecycle (SDLC) as well as the agile methodology for software development. Our teams situated in offshore and onshore locations support you in your entire product life cycle through development, maintenance, tech support and technical documentation. Our approach is transparency at all levels, cooperation in partnership, and collaboration in all that we do. Trust is our biggest asset and it is the cornerstone of our business success. We therefore invest considerable amount of our time in getting comprehensive knowledge of your business before beginning work. While we certainly assure you the cost-advantage, we deliver the highest quality through well-established processes and time tested methodologies that contribute to the overall efficiency of our operations.
